Gamemode: Nebula
Name: Tribus (Latin for Three)
Teams:
Aquam (Latin for water) color: blue 
Ignem (Latin for fire) color: red

Equitment:

A bit about us: 
We started this design about a month ago and have changed stuff conatantly. Please feel free to suggest changes. The map is made so the islands are jumpable. This decreases void, which I hear is what is wanted. The monuments are approximately 15 blocks away from spawn and aren't easy to get to. This map is trying to encourage PvP. 
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/la0g3btybalik2e/Nebula_map.rar
YML: (Will do if the map is accepted)
Thanks for viewing! :D

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Well, the map itself is too small, and the islands don't really match too much...
The gameplay wouldn't be really good, there's not enough space to tunnel, and the map is too simple itself.

Try making the map bigger, by either expanding the already existent islands or adding more (but bigger) islands, I don't really know what you should do about the themes, I'll let you decide on that :)
Make it thicker, so players are allowed to tunnel, also you could perhaps add more detail to it.
Good luck with your map, Snake! ^_^

replies.body: Ooh, I really like it! I think the player-limit should be about 40, though, because it's a pretty small map.
